summary: Every requirement, ruling and acceptance criterion V01–V22 has work to point at. P1 (pull policy and drift replay) and P2 (Jenkinsfile.promote) are in KubeCoderDeploy. Everything else is a step of P3's kubecoder-cutover.md, in the ruled order, and argocd.md's diff table is corrected. What the plan leaves open is the operator's live cutover, and Q1 (argocd-hook:1's Terraform 1.15.8 fails B3) is already a ruling in the close-out. The remaining close-out entries are advisory, so none of them is worth a phase. B2, the pre-flight's Secret dump, has a note that it bears on V20. Two nits in files this slice touched are fixed and committed: KubeCoderDeploy a340167 (S4) and Ansible 2b873dc (B3). Lint and test are green on both.
